property_summary: Creating a new EmergencyOracle via newEmergencyOracle can only succeed when msg.sender equals jojoTeam (i.e. calls forwarded through other contracts where msg.sender != jojoTeam must revert).
change_summary: Modify the onlyJojoTeam modifier to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so calls forwarded through other contracts may now be allowed or rejected, changing whether newEmergencyOracle can be called and thus the resulting newOracle state.
